# datadog_integration_openai_model_inference_account (Resource)

Provides a Datadog OpenAI Model Inference integration account resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `authentication` (Attributes) Authentication configured on the OpenAI Model Inference integration account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication))
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the OpenAI Model Inference integration account.
- `settings` (Attributes) Settings configured on the OpenAI Model Inference integration account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings))

### Optional

- `dataflows` (Attributes) Data Datadog collects from OpenAI Model Inference, keyed by dataflow ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--authentication"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication`

Optional:

- `open_ai_model_inference_integration_account_bearer_token_auth` (Attributes) The bearer token authentication method configured on the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication--open_ai_model_inference_integration_account_bearer_token_auth))

<a id="nestedatt--authentication--open_ai_model_inference_integration_account_bearer_token_auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication.open_ai_model_inference_integration_account_bearer_token_auth`

Optional:

- `auth_type` (String) The authentication method type. Valid values are `bearer_token`. Defaults to `"bearer_token"`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Secret token used to authenticate with OpenAI. Exactly one of `token` or `token_wo` must be set. Prefer `token_wo`, which Terraform 1.11+ keeps out of state; this attribute is stored in Terraform state.
- `token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Secret token used to authenticate with OpenAI. This write-only value is not stored in Terraform state. Requires Terraform 1.11+.
- `token_wo_version` (String) Version trigger for token_wo rotation. String length must be at least 1.



<a id="nestedatt--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings`

Optional:

- `custom_tags` (String) Comma-separated list of custom tags applied to the data collected for this account, for example `team:ai,env:prod`.


<a id="nestedatt--dataflows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows`

Optional:

- `openai_llm_completions` (Attributes) Makes the key in `authentication` available to run evaluations in [LLM Observability](https://docs.datadoghq.com/llm_observability/). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--openai_llm_completions))
- `openai_project_cloud_cost_data` (Attributes) Costs of the OpenAI project that owns the key in `authentication`. Analyze these costs in [Cloud Cost Management](https://docs.datadoghq.com/cloud_cost_management/). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--openai_project_cloud_cost_data))

<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--openai_llm_completions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.openai_llm_completions`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Datadog collects this data.

Read-Only:

- `status` (Attributes) Read-only collection status of a dataflow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--openai_llm_completions--status))

<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--openai_llm_completions--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.openai_llm_completions.status`

Read-Only:

- `health` (String) Collection health of a single dataflow.
- `message` (String) Human-readable detail, populated when the dataflow is not healthy.
- `updated_at` (String) Time the status was last computed.
